choose.title: Choose your language
choose.description: Select the language you want to use. You can change it at any time.

choose.title: Which device are you using?
choose.description: Choose the brand to load its support path and visual experience.

itel.tagline: Simple support for every itel device

choose.title: How would you like to collect the logs?
choose.description: We will tailor each instruction to the tools you have available.

pc.title: Using a computer
pc.description: I have access to a Windows computer and a USB data cable.

mobile.title: Using only my phone
mobile.description: I do not have access to a computer right now.

resume.title: Welcome back
resume.description: Your last {{brand}} guide is saved at step {{step}}.

guide.keyboardHint: Tip: use ← and → to move between steps.

adb.title: Android SDK Platform-Tools
adb.description: The official Google package containing ADB and Fastboot for Windows.
adb.acknowledgment: I downloaded ADB and can access the ZIP file.

official.title: Official download
official.description: This button points to Google's permanent download URL, which always serves the current Platform-Tools package.

menu.title: Menu names may vary
menu.description: The wording can differ slightly by model and system version. Use Settings search if needed.

authorization.title: Check the phone screen
authorization.description: When asked, allow USB debugging and optionally trust this computer. The list should then show the status “device”.

terminal.title: Keep this window open
terminal.description: The command stays active while logs are recorded. Do not close the terminal until the issue has been reproduced.

privacy.title: Protect personal information
privacy.description: Logs and screen recordings may contain names, notifications or account details. Review files before sharing them.

saved.title: Files ready
saved.description: Keep the log, recording and a short description of the time the issue occurred together.

adbFolder.caption: The extracted folder should contain adb, fastboot and support libraries.

download.title: Prepare your computer
download.description: Before collecting logs, download Android Debug Bridge (ADB). It lets your computer communicate securely with the device.

extract.title: Extract the Platform-Tools folder
extract.description: Unpack the ZIP into an easy-to-find folder before continuing.

items.download: Wait until the ZIP download is complete.
items.extract: Right-click the file and choose Extract all.
items.keep: Keep this folder open for the next steps.

developer.title: Enable Developer options
developer.infinix: On your Infinix, open Settings › My phone, then tap Build number seven times until XOS confirms developer mode.
developer.tecno: On your TECNO, open Settings › My phone, then tap Build number seven times until HiOS confirms developer mode.
developer.itel: On your itel, open Settings › My phone, then tap Build number seven times until developer mode is enabled.

usb.title: Turn on USB debugging
usb.description: Open Developer options and allow the computer to communicate with your device through ADB.

items.open: Go to Settings › System › Developer options.
items.confirm: Read and accept the security confirmation.

connect.title: Connect and verify the device
connect.description: Use a data-capable USB cable, open a terminal inside platform-tools and run the verification command.

capture.title: Start logs and screen recording
capture.description: Clear old messages, start a recording and save new Android logs to a text file.

reproduce.title: Reproduce the issue
reproduce.description: With capture running, repeat the exact actions that cause the problem. Note the approximate time and what you expected to happen.

export.title: Stop and copy the evidence
export.description: Press Ctrl+C in the logcat terminal, then run the commands below to finish the recording and copy it to your computer.

finish.title: Review and send
finish.description: Confirm that your support package contains everything needed for analysis.

items.log: The text log opens and contains recent timestamps.
items.context: Include the issue time, steps and expected result.
items.disable: Disable USB debugging after support is complete.

prepare.title: Prepare your phone
prepare.description: A bug report can be large and may take several minutes to generate.

items.storage: Reserve at least 1 GB of free storage.

report.title: Start a bug report
report.description: In Developer options, choose Take bug report and select the interactive or full report.

items.select: Tap Take bug report and choose Interactive report.
items.start: Confirm to begin collecting diagnostic data.

info.title: Can't find the option?
info.description: Search Settings for “bug report”. Some software versions place it under Developer options › Bug report.

reproduce.description: Return to the affected app and reproduce the issue while Android collects the report. Avoid opening unrelated personal content.

wait.title: Wait for the report
wait.description: A notification shows collection progress. Keep the phone unlocked and wait until Android says the report is ready.

share.title: Share the generated report
share.description: Open the completed notification, choose Share and send the ZIP only through the support channel you trust.

info.title: Large attachment
info.description: If your email app rejects the file, upload it to your approved company drive and share a restricted link.

finish.description: Confirm that support received the report and a short description of the issue.
finish.success: Your on-device diagnostic package is ready for technical analysis.

completion.title: Your support package is ready
completion.description: You completed every step. Review any sensitive information before sending the files to support.
